answer_1.quote: We consider the task of news headline generation... We instead propose updated headline generation, which entails updating headlines based on changes to the content of the article.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate with common text-generation metrics: METEOR, ROUGE-L. ... we also use two edit-specific metrics: GLEU and SARI.

answer_4.quote: We conduct a human evaluation of the (more performant) BART models... Annotators were presented with a visual diff between B1 and B2 along with H1, and were asked to judge a candidate updated headline according to five dimensions on a Likert scale.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rated each candidate headline on five dimensions: factuality, grammaticality, focus on important changes, minimal edits, and headlinese, using a Likert scale.
